name: Bulk location actions
description:
##  POST /api/v1/locations/bulk

Bulk actions allow to make changes to multiple locations in a single request. The following actions are supported:

- archive
- restore
- delete

All of these actions require an array of location ids to perform the requested action on ie.

"ids":['id1','id2']
whenToUse: Archive, restore, or delete many locations at once by passing an array of ids plus an action (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

fields.name: action
fields.description: The action to perform ie. archive / restore / delete
